title: Apple Fitness Workout-Type Diversity Drop
app: COROS, Wahoo ELEMNT, TrainerRoad, Apple Fitness / HealthKit exports, Concept2 Logbook, Strava, Garmin Connect, and Zwift activity feeds via official APIs, FIT/CSV exports, and Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=applefitness:workout
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats dc(workout_type) as workout_types, count as sessions by athlete _time
| where sessions>=10 AND workout_types<3
| sort workout_types
description: Uses Apple Fitness workout exports telemetry to monitor variety across logged workout types in index=personal.
value: Splunk turns the feed into an operational check for months when routine diversity collapsed, so the signal does not stay buried inside separate consumer apps or exports.
implementation: Ingest Apple Fitness workout exports data through its real API, export, MQTT bridge, or open-source connector into `index=personal`; preserve the fields referenced in the SPL and schedule the search on a weekly cadence.
visualization: Monthly table of sessions versus distinct workout types.
grandmaExplanation: It gathers variety across logged workout types so you can spot months when routine diversity collapsed before it becomes annoying.
